<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Sound Point Luna LLC</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Sound Point Meridian Management Company LLC</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Sound Point Commercial Real Estate Finance LLC</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">SPCRE InPoint Advisors, LLC</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>FINAL AS OF OCTOBER 1, 2025</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2pt solid"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin: 0"><B><U><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase">Code of Ethics</FONT></U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">This Code of Ethics (&ldquo;Code&rdquo;) is adopted in compliance with the requirements of U.S. securities laws applicable to registered investment advisers. Registered investment advisers are required by Rule&nbsp;204A-1 under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, as amended (&ldquo;Advisers Act&rdquo;) and Rule&nbsp;17j-1 under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (&ldquo;Investment Company Act&rdquo;) (where applicable), to adopt a code of ethics which, among other things, sets forth the standards of business conduct required of their Supervised Persons and Access Persons and requires those individuals to comply with the federal securities laws. This Code has been adopted to prevent prohibited conduct as set forth below.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">1.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Standards of Business Conduct</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">Sound Point seeks to foster a reputation for integrity and professionalism. That reputation is a vital business asset. The confidence and trust placed in us by our clients is something we value and endeavor to protect. To further that goal, we have adopted this Code and implemented policies and procedures to prevent fraudulent, deceptive, and manipulative practices and to ensure compliance with the Federal Securities Laws and the fiduciary duties owed to our clients.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">1.1.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Fiduciary Duty</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">We are fiduciaries and as such, we have affirmative duties of care, honesty, loyalty and good faith to act in the best interests of our clients. Our clients&rsquo; interests are paramount and come before our personal interests. Our Access Persons and Supervised Persons, as those terms are defined in this Code, are also expected to behave as fiduciaries with respect to our clients. This means that each must render disinterested advice, protect client assets (including nonpublic information about a client or a client account) and act always in the best interest of our clients. We must also strive to identify and avoid conflicts of interest; however, such conflicts may arise.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0; text-align: justify">Supervised Persons and Access Persons of Sound Point must not:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">employ any device, scheme or artifice to defraud a client;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">make to a client any untrue statement of a material fact or omit to state to a client a material fact necessary in order to make the statements made, in light of the circumstances under which they are made, not misleading;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">engage in any act, practice, or course of business which operates or would operate as a fraud or deceit upon a client;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">engage in any manipulative practice with respect to a client;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">use their positions, or any investment opportunities presented by virtue of their positions, to personal advantage or to the detriment of a client; or</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">conduct personal trading activities in contravention of this Code or applicable legal principles or in such a manner as may be inconsistent with the duties owed to clients as a fiduciary.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">1.2.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Fair Treatment</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">Supervised Persons and Access Persons must avoid taking any action which would favor one client or group of clients over another, in violation of our fiduciary duties and applicable law. Supervised Persons and Access Persons must comply with relevant provisions of this Manual designed to detect, prevent, or mitigate such conflicts.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 2; Options: NewSection; Value: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2pt solid"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->2<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">To ensure compliance with these restrictions and the Federal Securities Laws, as defined in this Code, we have adopted, and agreed to be governed by, the provisions of this Code. However, Supervised Persons and Access Persons are expected to comply not merely with the &ldquo;letter of the law,&rdquo; but also with the spirit of the law, this Code, and Sound Point&rsquo;s Investment Adviser Policies and Procedures Manual.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">Should you have any doubt as to whether this Code applies to you, please contact the Chief Compliance Officer of Sound Point (&ldquo;CCO&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">2.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Definitions</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0; text-align: justify">As used in the Code, the following terms have the following meanings:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B><I>Access Person</I></B> is a Supervised Person who has access to nonpublic information regarding clients&rsquo; purchase or sale of securities, is involved in making securities recommendations to clients or who has access to such recommendations that are nonpublic. With the exception of James Carey and Dominic Frederico, who are subject to oversight by Stone Point and Assured Guaranty respectively and have no access to Sound Point&rsquo;s portfolio, all Supervised Persons of Sound Point are generally presumed to be Access Persons.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B><I>Beneficial Ownership</I></B> generally means (i) having a direct or indirect pecuniary interest in a security and is legally defined to be a beneficial owner as such term is used in Rule&nbsp;16a-1(a)(2) under Section&nbsp;16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &ldquo;Exchange Act&rdquo;); (ii) joint accounts; (iii) accounts of any Family Member (as defined in this Code); (iv) an estate for the benefit of the Access Person or Family Member; (v) accounts of any person in a relationship with the Access Person that the CCO determines could lead to conflicts of interest; or (vi) accounts where the Access Person exercises investment control. However, transactions or holdings reports required by this Code may contain a statement that the report will not be construed as an admission that the person making the report has any direct or indirect beneficial ownership in the security or securities to which the report relates.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B><I>Family Member</I></B> means the Access Person&rsquo;s spouse, domestic partner, parent, step-parent, child, step-child, sibling, grandparent or in-law (including mother, father, sister, brother, daughter or son) or relatives sharing the same household as the Access Person.<SUP>1</SUP></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B><I>Federal Securities Laws</I></B> means: (i) the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &ldquo;Securities Act&rdquo;); (ii) Exchange Act; (iii) the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002; (iv) the Investment Company Act; (v) the Advisers Act; (vi) Title V of the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act; (vii) any rules adopted by the SEC under the foregoing statutes; (viii) the Bank Secrecy Act, as it applies to funds and investment advisers; and (ix) any rules adopted under relevant provisions of the Bank Secrecy Act by the SEC or the Department of the Treasury.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B><I>3rd Party Managed Accounts</I></B> means a Securities Account for which an Access Person has completely relinquished decision making authority to a professional money manager (who is not a Family Member or not otherwise subject to this Code) and over which the Access Person has no direct or indirect influence or control.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B><I>Initial Public Offering (&ldquo;IPO&rdquo;)</I></B> means an offering of securities registered under the Securities Act, the issuer of which, immediately before the registration, was not subject to the reporting requirements of Exchange Act Sections&nbsp;13 or 15(d).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B><I>Limited Offering</I></B> means an offering that is exempt from registration under Securities Act Sections&nbsp;4(a)(2) or 4(a)(6), or pursuant to Securities Act Rules&nbsp;504, 505 or 506. Limited Offerings include, without limitation, offerings of securities issued by the private funds advised by Sound Point.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<!-- Field: Rule-Page --><DIV STYLE="width: 25%"><DIV STYLE="border-top: Black 1pt solid; font-size: 1pt">&nbsp;</DIV></DIV><!-- Field: /Rule-Page -->

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><SUP>1</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The definition of Family Member does not typically include house mates or roommates unless that individual qualifies as a domestic partner or is an individual that would benefit in a manner substantially equivalent to that of ownership. If you are unsure whether an individual in your household meets the definition of a Family Member, please reach out to Compliance for verification.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 3; Value: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2pt solid"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->3<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B><I>Purchase or Sale of a Security</I></B> includes, among other things, the writing of an option to purchase or sell a security.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B><I>Reportable Security</I></B> are all securities as defined in Advisers Act Section&nbsp;202(a)(18) and Investment Company Act Section&nbsp;2(a)(36), including listed and unlisted securities, private transactions (including private placements, non-public stock, warrants, etc.), EXCEPT: (i) direct obligations of the United States Government; (ii) bankers&rsquo; acceptances, bank certificates of deposit, commercial paper and high quality short-term debt instruments, including repurchase agreements; (iii) shares issued by money market funds; (iv) shares issued by Investment Company Act registered open-end funds that are not advised or sub-advised by Sound Point; and (v) shares issued by unit investment trusts that are invested exclusively in one or more open-end funds.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B><I>Security Held</I></B> by a Client means any Reportable Security which is currently held as an investment in any Sound Point managed fund or account. This definition also includes any option to purchase or sell, and any security convertible into or exchangeable for, a Reportable Security.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B><I>Supervised Person</I></B> means any partner, member, officer, director (or other person occupying a similar status or performing similar functions) (excluding Stone Point employees), employees of Sound Point (including interns who work for four (4) weeks or more and contract employees), or other person who provides investment advice on behalf of Sound Point and is subject to the supervision and control of Sound Point. Sound Point may also designate any partner, officer, director (or other persons occupying a similar status or performing a similar function) or employee of any independent contractor or other third-party as deemed appropriate as a Supervised Person.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>Upon joining the Firm,</B> Access Persons are required to disclose the following to Compliance <B>within 10 calendar days </B>of becoming an Access Person:</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.95in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><U>All</U> investments, including Reportable Securities holdings and private investments, held/beneficially owned by the Access Person and Family Members (also known as the &ldquo;<B><I>Initial Holdings Report</I></B>&rdquo;).</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.95in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><U>All</U> Securities Accounts and Associated Accounts maintained with any broker, dealer, investment adviser, bank or other financial institution.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>All Access Persons will be given a username and password in <I>MyComplianceOffice</I>, the Firm&rsquo;s automated compliance reporting and surveillance system. Securities Accounts and Associated Accounts are reported to Compliance via <I>MyComplianceOffice</I>.</B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">While not all Securities Accounts and Associated Accounts require ongoing reporting to Compliance, initial disclosure of such accounts to Compliance is required (Note: <I>Disclosure of personal checking and savings accounts <U>is not</U> required).</I></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The following are examples of the types of Securities Accounts and Associated Accounts that require disclosure to Compliance upon joining the Firm: </TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>


<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="3" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="border-top: Black 1pt solid; border-left: Black 1pt solid; vertical-align: bottom; width: 3.25in; text-align: center"><B>Securities Accounts</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="border-right: Black 1pt solid; border-top: Black 1pt solid; border-left: Black 1pt solid; vertical-align: bottom; width: 3.25in; text-align: center"><B>Associated Accounts</B></TD> </TR>
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; border-top: Black 1pt solid; border-left: Black 1pt solid; vertical-align: top">Securities Accounts maintained with any broker, dealer, investment adviser, bank or other financial institution that are beneficially owned or controlled by the Access Person</TD>
    <TD STYLE="border-right: Black 1pt solid; border-top: Black 1pt solid; border-left: Black 1pt solid; text-align: justify; vertical-align: top">Securities Accounts maintained with any broker, dealer, investment adviser, bank or other financial institution that are beneficially owned or controlled by Family Member(s)</TD> </TR>
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; border-top: Black 1pt solid; border-left: Black 1pt solid; vertical-align: top">3<SUP>rd</SUP> Party Managed Account of the Access Person that are fully managed by a third-party broker-dealer or investment advisers</TD>
    <TD STYLE="border-right: Black 1pt solid; border-top: Black 1pt solid; border-left: Black 1pt solid; text-align: justify; vertical-align: top">3<SUP>rd</SUP> Party Managed Account of Family Member(s) that are fully managed by a third-party broker-dealer or investment advisers</TD> </TR>
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; border-top: Black 1pt solid; border-left: Black 1pt solid; vertical-align: top">Securities Accounts of the Access Person which hold only non-Reportable Securities (e.g., employer 401k accounts, 529 college savings accounts, IRA accounts)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="border-right: Black 1pt solid; border-top: Black 1pt solid; border-left: Black 1pt solid; text-align: justify; vertical-align: top">Securities Accounts of Family Member(s) which holds only non-Reportable Securities (e.g., employer 401k accounts, 529 college savings accounts, IRA accounts)</TD> </TR>
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; border-top: Black 1pt solid; border-left: Black 1pt solid; vertical-align: top">Securities accounts over which the Access Person controls or directs securities trading for another person or entity, even if the Access Person is not the Beneficial Owner of the account</TD>
    <TD STYLE="border-right: Black 1pt solid; border-top: Black 1pt solid; border-left: Black 1pt solid; text-align: justify; vertical-align: top">Securities Accounts over which a Family Member controls or directs securities trading for another person or entity, even if the Family Member is not the Beneficial Owner of the account</TD> </TR>
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid; border-left: Black 1pt solid; border-top: Black 1pt solid; vertical-align: top">Crypto-currency accounts beneficially owned or controlled by the Access Person</TD>
    <TD STYLE="border: Black 1pt solid; text-align: justify; vertical-align: top">Crypto-currency accounts beneficially owned or controlled by a Family Member</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>Approved Broker Requirement. </B>Access Persons joining Sound Point with existing Securities Accounts and/or Associated Accounts that are maintained at a broker-dealer that does not provide an automated data feed of the transactions effected in the account to Sound Point&rsquo;s automated compliance and reporting surveillance system, <I>MyComplianceOffice</I>, will be required to transfer the securities held in the account to a broker-dealer on the Approved Broker List (see below) unless an exception is granted by the CCO. <I>The Approved Broker List and exceptions to the approved broker requirement are provided in Section&nbsp;4 below.</I></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The <B><I>Initial Holdings Report</I></B> provided to Compliance must be current as of a date no more than forty-five (45) days prior to the date the individual becomes an Access Person and include, among other things:</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">the title and type of security and as applicable, the exchange ticker symbol or CUSIP number (if applicable), number of shares, and principal amount of each security;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">the name of any broker, dealer or bank with which the Access Person maintains an account in which any securities are held for the Access Person&rsquo;s direct or indirect benefit (please note that 3rd Party Managed Accounts and accounts which hold only non-Reportable Securities, must also be disclosed); and,</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">the date the Access Person submits the report.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>New Employees: </B>New employees have the option to submit their Initial Holdings to Compliance prior to their first day of joining Sound Point so that Compliance can reconcile any Reportable Securities against Sound Point&rsquo;s permanent restricted list so that the new employees will have the opportunity to sell holdings before they are obliged to hold such Reportable Securities for the duration of their restricted status or employment at Sound Point, whichever is shorter.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><I>Annual Holdings Reports</I></B>: Access Persons are required to submit to Compliance <I>via MyComplianceOffice</I> their Reportable Securities annually, on a date selected by the CCO, as of a date not more than forty five (45) days prior to the date the report was submitted. <I>The Annual Holdings Report must contain the same information that is required in the Initial Holdings Report.</I></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Access Persons with Securities Accounts and/or Associated Accounts maintained with a broker-dealer on the Approved Broker List automatically meet this requirement provided the automatic feed between the Approved Broker and Sound Point&rsquo;s automated compliance and reporting surveillance system, <I>MyComplianceOffice, </I>has been established for the relevant account<I>.</I></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Access Persons with Securities Accounts and/or Associated Accounts that have been granted an exception to the Approved Broker List requirement by the CCO are obligated to meet the duplicate statement requirement outlined in Section&nbsp;3.5 below.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Access Persons are required to submit to Compliance via <I>MyComplianceOffice</I> a report covering all transactions in Reportable Securities during the preceding calendar quarter within thirty (30) calendar days after the end of each calendar quarter.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><I>Quarterly Transaction Reports</I></B> uploaded to <I>MyComplianceOffice</I> must contain the following information:</TD> </TR>

  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">

  </TABLE>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Matching of Reports</FONT></B></TD> </TR>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Reports submitted pursuant to this Section&nbsp;3 shall be matched (i) to prior pre-approval submissions to confirm Access Persons are correctly requesting necessary pre-approvals and (ii) to Initial Holdings Reports to ensure all Reportable Securities are disclosed.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2pt solid"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->6<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">3.5.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Exceptions to Quarterly and Annual Reporting Obligations: </FONT></B>Exceptions to the quarterly and annual reporting obligations are only granted under limited circumstances at the discretion of the CCO. Please note, none of the exceptions noted below apply to the initial reporting requirement outlined in Section&nbsp;3.1 above.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">3rd Party Managed Accounts are generally exempt from ongoing reporting requirements. Please note, evidence of 3<SUP>rd</SUP> party full trading discretion is required to qualify for this exception <I>(i.e.</I>, Investment Management Agreement and/or Attestation Letter provided by the 3<SUP>rd</SUP> party manager).</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Securities Accounts and/or Associated Accounts that do not have the ability to trade Reportable Securities (<I>i.e.</I>, most employer sponsored 401k programs, 529 college savings plans, which are generally limited to trading mutual funds or are fully managed) are generally exempt from the ongoing reporting requirements outlined herein. Please note, evidence of the necessary account limitations is required to qualify for this exception.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Access Persons will be notified by Compliance in writing after submitting their Initial Holdings Report (or a new account pre-clearance request) if any of their Securities Accounts and/or Associated Accounts qualify for an exception to the ongoing reporting requirements outlined herein. Exceptions to the ongoing reporting obligations can only be granted by Compliance in writing and are granted at the discretion of the CCO. Please do not make this determination on your own.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>Duplicate Statement Requirements</B>: certain Securities Accounts and Associated Accounts that have been granted an exception to the quarterly and annual reporting obligations by the CCO will be required to meet the Duplicate Statement Requirement, which requires the provision of monthly brokerage statements to Compliance.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>Quarterly Attestation Requirement:</B> Access Persons who represent that their Securities Accounts and/or Associated Accounts meet one of the expressed exceptions set forth herein will be required to attest on a quarterly basis that the subject account(s) still qualifies for the exception.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">4.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Opening a New Securities Account and/or Associated Account</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B>4.1.</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Pre-Approval Required.</FONT></B> Before opening a new Securities Account and/or Associated Account, Access Persons are required to obtain pre-clearance from Compliance. Pre-clearance requests can be submitted via <I>MyComplianceOffice</I>.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B>4.2.</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Approved Broker Requirement.</FONT></B> Access Persons (both U.S. and U.K. based) may only open new Securities Accounts and/or Associated Accounts with financial institutions on the Approved Broker List. As noted below, exceptions to the Approved Broker List requirement are only granted under limited circumstances at the discretion of the CCO.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">

  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-indent: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Access Persons may not engage in a transaction in any Reportable Securities absent prior approval in writing from the CCO (or their designee):</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Reportable Securities are defined in <B>Section&nbsp;2</B> above.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">When considering an Access Person&rsquo;s request to engage in a transaction involving a Reportable Security, the CCO shall consider whether the transaction involves a Reportable Security on Sound Point&rsquo;s Restricted List/Watch or is a Reportable Security held by a Client, in which case the approval shall not be granted, and whether the transaction is otherwise consistent with the Code.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Pre-clearance is required for transactions in Sound Point Meridian Capital, Inc.(NYSE: SPMC) as well as any future registered fund advised and/or sub-advised by Sound Point.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Pre-clearance is required for transactions in derivatives of any security, including those exempted from the definition of Reportable Security (<I>e.g.</I>, transactions in ETF options require pre-clearance).</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>Private Placements.</B> Access Persons may not engage in any transaction made by private placement absent prior approval in writing from the CCO (or their designee). Access Persons shall preclear all new and additional subscriptions to private placements, including Sound Point managed funds, through <I>MyComplianceOffice</I>. NOTE: <I>capital calls related to an approved investment in a drawdown fund do not require pre-clearance provided the full capital commitment was previously pre-cleared with Compliance.</I>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">5.2.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Pre-Clearance Process</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Pre-clearance can be obtained via <I>MyComplianceOffice</I>.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The number of shares or contracts precleared should be the same or greater than the contemplated size of the personal trade.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Pre-approval shall be valid for the date of such approval and the next trading day (commonly known as &ldquo;T+1&rdquo;). If execution is not completed by T+1, the approval will be stale, and a new pre-approval must be obtained.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">5.3.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Exceptions/Modifications to the Preclearance Requirement/Process</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><U>Exception for 3rd Party Managed Accounts</U>: transactions in Reportable Securities held in 3rd Party Managed Accounts do not require pre-clearance provided the Access Person has provided Compliance with sufficient evidence that the account meets the definition of a 3rd Party Managed Account and makes the required quarterly attestations that the account continues to meet the definition.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><U>Exception for Specified Securities</U>: The securities listed below, regardless of the type of account they are held in, are exempt from being classified as Reportable Securities and, consequently, do not require pre-clearance:</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.95in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Shares of exchange-traded funds (<I>e.g.</I>, ETFs, ETNs, ETPs), except for CLO ETFs or narrow-based ETFs<SUP>2</SUP></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.95in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Mutual Funds, 40 Act Open End Funds, and 40 Act Closed End Funds <U>not</U> advised or sub-advised by Sound Point, <U>or a competitor</U> to a Sound Point advised fund.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.95in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Money Market Funds</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.95in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">U.S. 529 Investment Plans</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">US Government Obligations</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.95in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Cryptocurrency</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><U>Exception for Forced Option Sale</U>: the forced sale upon the expiration of an option does not require pre-clearance given the expiration date is known at the time of purchase;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><U>Exception/Modification for DRIPs</U>: Reportable Securities acquired through automatic dividend reinvestment programs do not generally require preclearance; however, <B>Compliance must be notified of the election in advance</B>. <I>Please note, although Reportable Securities acquired via an automatic dividend reinvestment program do not require preclearance, discretionary transactions by an Access Person in the Reportable Security require preclearance and if such Reportable Security is on the Restricted List/Watch List or is Client held, approval may not be granted.</I></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><U>Modification for Corporate Actions</U>: a forced transaction in a Reportable Security due to a corporate action &ndash; given the exact time/date of the transaction is not commonly known &ndash; Access Persons are required to pre-clear once they are notified that a forced transaction is pending due to an upcoming corporate action.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD>

    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">A narrow-based ETF is typically comprised of a limited number of companies and focuses on a specific sector, industry, or market segment, as opposed to a broker market index.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>
