    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2pt solid"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->9<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">5.4.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Prohibited Personal Trading Activities:</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>Transactions in Securities of Restricted List issuers.</B> Access Persons may not engage in a transaction in any security of any issuer on Sound Point&rsquo;s Restricted List. An exception for a Reportable Security acquired through an automatic dividend reinvestment program may be granted if the Reportable Security was acquired and the decision to participate in the automatic dividend reinvestment program was effected prior to the issuer being added to Sound Point&rsquo;s Restricted List.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>Transactions in Securities Held by a Client.</B> Access Persons may not engage in a transaction in any security that is currently held, or contemplated to be held, by a Sound Point managed account or fund. NOTE: Shares of exchange-traded funds and registered closed-end funds not advised or sub-advised by Sound Point are exempt from this requirement.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>IPO and Limited Offering Restrictions. </B>Access Persons may not acquire any securities issued as part of an IPO or a Limited Offering, absent prior approval in writing from the CCO. Any such approval will take into account, among other factors, whether the investment opportunity should be reserved for a client and whether the investment opportunity is being offered to the person because of their position with Sound Point.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>Personal Borrowing via Marketplace Lending Platforms. </B>Access Persons may not personally borrow through marketplace lending platforms such as Lending Club, Prosper, or Lending Point.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>Special Purpose Acquisition Company (&ldquo;SPAC&rdquo;). </B>Access Persons may not transact in any SPAC in their personal accounts, including in SPACs that had identified a target company but is awaiting shareholder approval or otherwise has yet to consummate the purchase.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>Options on Single Name Securities.</B> Access Persons may not transact in options on single name securities.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">5.5.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Thirty (30) Day Holding Period</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Absent the prior written consent of the CCO, transactions in Reportable Securities by an Access Person within thirty (30) calendar days of a transaction in the same Reportable Security in the opposite direction are not permitted.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">For example, if an Access Person sells a Reportable Security, they are not permitted to buy the same Reportable Security until the 30 Day Holding Period has expired.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Conversely, if an Access Person buys a Reportable Security, they are not permitted to sell that Reportable Security until the 30 Day Holding Period has expired.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Please see Section&nbsp;5.7 below for details on how the Holding Period impacts trading of permitted options contracts.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">5.6.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Exceptions / Modifications to the 30 Day Holding Period:</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><U>Exception</U>: transactions in cryptocurrency are not subject to the 30 Day Holding Period.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><U>Exception</U>: transactions in government and municipal authority securities, obligations of the U.S. Government; bankers&rsquo; acceptances; CDs; commercial paper; high quality short-term debt instruments, including repos; money market funds; registered open-ended funds (<I>i.e.,</I> mutual funds) and registered closed-end funds <U>not</U> advised or sub-advised by Sound Point <U>or a competitor</U> to a Sound Point advised fund are not subject to the 30 Day Holding Period.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>



<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><U>Exception for 3rd Party Managed Accounts</U>: transactions in Reportable Securities held in 3rd Party Managed Accounts are not subject to the 30 Day Holding Period.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>


<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 10; Value: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2pt solid"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->10<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">5.7.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Options Contracts</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>Options on Single Name Equity.</B> Access Persons may not transact in any options on single name equities.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>Options on Exchange-Traded Funds</B>. Access Persons are permitted to engage in transactions involving options on exchange-traded funds (<I>e.g.,</I> SPY) but should note that permitted options transactions are subject to Sound Point&rsquo;s 30-day holding period requirement.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>Impact of Holding Period Requirement on Permitted Options Contracts</B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.95in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Transacting in offsetting options contracts within the same 30 day time period is not permitted.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.95in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Exercising an option contract that effects an opposite directional trade of a Reportable Security purchased or sold within the same 30 day time period is not permitted. For example, you purchase SPY on January&nbsp;1 and also buy a put option on SPY or sell a call option on SPY (both of which have the equivalent effect of a sale transaction), you can&rsquo;t exercise the option contract until 30 days after your purchase of SPY (January&nbsp;31) because the exercise of the option would result in an effective sale of the ETF within the 30 day holding period.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B>6.</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Prohibition on Self Pre-clearance or Approval</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">Access Persons shall not pre-clear their own trades, review their own reports or approve their own exemptions from this Code. When such actions are to be undertaken with respect to the CCO, the Chief Financial Officer (or their designee) will perform such actions as are required of the CCO by this Code.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">7.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Code Notification and Access Persons Certifications</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">The CCO shall provide notice to all Access Persons of their status under this Code and shall deliver a copy of the Code to each Access Person annually. Additionally, each Access Person will be provided a copy of any significant Code amendments upon such amendment. After reading the Code or amendment, each Access Person shall make the initial certification contained in <I>MyComplianceOffice</I>. Annual certifications are due within ten (10) days after the end of each calendar year. Certifications with respect to amendments to the Code, if requested, must be returned to the CCO within a reasonably prompt time. Both of these certificates are also available on <I>MyComplianceOffice</I> and will be generated by Compliance as required. To the extent that any Code-related training sessions or seminars are held, the CCO shall keep records of such sessions and the Access Persons attending.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">8.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Review of Required Code Reports</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B>8.1.</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Reports required to be submitted pursuant to the Code will be reviewed by the CCO or a designee on a periodic basis.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B>8.2.</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Any material violation or potential material violation of the Code must be promptly reported to the CCO. The CCO will investigate any such violation or potential violation and determine the nature and severity of the violation. All violations will be handled on a case-by-case basis in a manner deemed appropriate by the CCO. In each case of a violation, the CCO must determine what actions, if any, are required to cure the violation and prevent future violations.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B>8.3.</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The CCO will keep a written record of all investigations in connection with any Code violations, including any action taken as a result of the violation.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B>8.4.</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">General sanctions are described in the <I>Compliance Monitoring Policy</I>. Sanctions for violations of the Code are subject to the CCO&rsquo;s discretion, but will generally adhere to the following sentencing guidelines:</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.95in; text-align: justify"><B><U>First Offense</U>:</B> A written warning from Compliance;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.95in; text-align: justify"><B><U>Second Offens</U>e: </B>30-day trading ban from personal trading, escalation of the offense to the Access Person&rsquo;s manager and the Compliance Committee, and mandatory retraining of the Code;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.95in; text-align: justify"><B><U>Third (Plus) Offense</U>:</B> 60-day trading ban from personal trading, escalation of the offense to the Access Person&rsquo;s manager and the Compliance Committee, mandatory retraining of the Code, and possible censure, monetary sanctions, disgorgement, suspension or dismissal.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.95in; text-align: justify">The CCO has discretion to take into account the duration of the Access Person&rsquo;s tenure, the severity of the offense(s) and the length of time since the employee&rsquo;s last breach when issuing sanctions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">9.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Recordkeeping and Review</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B>9.1.</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Sound Point will maintain records (which shall be available for examination by the SEC staff) in accordance with Sound Point&rsquo;s Recordkeeping Policy, and specifically shall maintain:</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(i)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">a copy of this Code and any other preceding code of ethics that, at any time within the past five (5) years, has been in effect in an easily accessible place;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(ii)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">a record of any Code violation and of any sanctions imposed for a period of not less than five (5) years following the end of the fiscal year in which the violation occurred, the first two (2) years in an easily accessible place;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(iii)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">a copy of each report made by an Access Person under this Code for a period of not less than five (5) years from the end of the fiscal year in which it is made, the first two (2) years in an easily accessible place;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(iv)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">a record of all persons who are, or within the past five (5) years have been, required to submit reports under this Code, or who are or were responsible for reviewing these reports for a period of at least five (5) years after the end of the fiscal year in which the report was submitted, the first two (2) years in an easily accessible place; and</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(v)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">a record of any decision, and the reasons supporting the decision, to approve the acquisition by an Access Person of securities acquired in an Initial Public Offering or Limited Offering, for a period of at least five (5) years after the end of the fiscal year in which the approval is granted, the first two (2) years in an easily accessible place.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">To the extent appropriate and permissible, the CCO may choose to keep such records electronically.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B>9.3.</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The CCO shall review this Code and its operation annually and may determine to make amendments to the Code as a result of that review. Annually, the CCO will, where required:</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.7in"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left">(i)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">create a written report that describes any material violations that arose under the Code since&nbsp;&nbsp;the last annual report, remedial steps taken, and sanctions imposed;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(ii)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">certify that Sound Point has adopted procedures reasonably necessary to prevent violations of the Code; and present this report and certification to Sound Point&rsquo;s Senior Management and to the Board of Trustees/Directors of all registered investment companies advised by Sound Point.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">10.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Reporting Violations</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">Any Supervised Person who believes that a violation of this Code has taken place must promptly report that violation to the CCO or to the CCO&rsquo;s designee. To the extent that such reports are provided to a designee, the designee shall provide periodic updates to the CCO with respect to violations reported. Supervised Persons may make these reports anonymously and no adverse action shall be taken against a Supervised Person making such a report in good faith.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">11.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Waivers</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">The CCO may grant waivers of any substantive restriction in appropriate circumstances (e.g., personal hardship) and will maintain records necessary to justify such waivers.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">12.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Confidentiality</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">All reports of securities transactions and other information filed pursuant to this Code shall be treated as confidential to the extent permitted by law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">13.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Gifts, rebates, contributions, or other payments</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">13.1.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">General Requirements</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">: </FONT></B>Sound Point will take reasonable steps to ensure that neither it nor its Supervised Persons offer or give, or solicit or accept, in the course of business, any inducements which may lead to conflicts of interest between Sound Point and its Clients.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Supervised Persons generally may not solicit gifts or gratuities nor give inducements, except in accordance with this Code.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The term &ldquo;inducements&rdquo; means gifts, entertainment and similar benefits which are offered to or given by Supervised Persons.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Gifts of nominal value or those that are customary in the industry such as meals or entertainment may be appropriate.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Any cash gift or any form of a loan by a Supervised Person to a Client or by a Client to a Supervised Person is prohibited (retailer/establishment specific gift cards are permissible, provided they are pre-approved).</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Gifts to/from government officials (here in the U.S. as well as abroad) is prohibited.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">A relaxation of, or exemption from, these procedures may only be granted by the CCO.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">13.2.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Pre-Clearance of Gifts and Entertainment.</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">The CCO (or their designee) has the authority to pre-approve gifts and entertainment in accordance with the provisions of this Code and will be responsible for maintaining the required books and records with respect to gifts and entertainment.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Pre-Clearance Requirements:</TD> </TR>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.95in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.95in; text-align: justify">any <U>inducement/gift</U> with a value greater than $150 (on a per person basis), <U>given or received</U> in connection with that Supervised Person&rsquo;s employment or association with Sound Point must be pre-cleared with Compliance.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.95in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">entertainment <U>given or received</U> with a value greater than $150 (on a per person basis) in connection with that Supervised Person&rsquo;s employment or association with Sound Point must be pre-cleared with Compliance.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.95in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B>NOTE: $0 pre-clearance threshold for any gift or entertainment (given or received) if such gift or entertainment involves trading counterparties, sell-side (<I>i.e</I>., broker/dealer community).</B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.95in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9675;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">For practical reasons, if said approval request was not submitted prior to the date of the entertainment, Supervised Persons are to report details of such entertainment to Compliance immediately after.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">14.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Outside Employment or Other Activities</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B>14.1.</B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">General Requirements</FONT>:</B> Supervised Persons are generally prohibited from being employed or compensated by any other entity, serving on the board of directors of any publicly traded companies, and similar conduct except with the prior authorization of the CCO. Any employment or other outside activity by a Supervised Person may result in possible conflicts of interests for the Supervised Person or for Sound Point and therefore must be reviewed and approved by the CCO. Outside activities, which must be reviewed and approved, include the following:</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(1)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">being employed or compensated by any other entity;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(2)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">engaging in any other business including part-time, evening or weekend employment; or</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(3)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">serving as an officer, director, partner, <I>etc.</I>, in any other entity (including on the investment committee or in a similar role of a charitable organization).</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">14.2.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Pre-Clearance Required:</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Written approval for any of the above activities is to be obtained by a Supervised Person before undertaking any such activity so that a determination may be made that the activities do not interfere with any of the Supervised Person&rsquo;s responsibilities at Sound Point and any conflicts of interest which may be created by such activities may be addressed.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Pre-Clearance for Outside Business Activities should be requested via <I>MyComplianceOffice</I>.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Supervised Person seeking approval shall provide the following information to the CCO: (1) the name and address of the outside business organization; (2) a description of the business of the organization; (3) compensation, if any, to be received; (4) a description of the activities to be performed; and (5) the amount of time per month that will be spent on the outside activity. Because Sound Point encourages Supervised Person involvement in charitable, nonpublic organization, civic and trade association activities, these outside activities will generally be approved unless a clear conflict of interest exists.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Supervised Persons must update annually any requests for approval of an outside activity.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Clients governed by the Investment Company Act, may place additional restrictions on outside business activities and the CCO shall ensure that Supervised Persons adhere to such restrictions.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.25in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">&#9679;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">Records of requests for approval along with the reasons such requests were granted or denied are maintained by the CCO in <I>MyComplianceOffice</I>. </TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">15.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Where/how to Submit Pre-Clearance Requests via MyComplianceOffice</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

Please note the corresponding submission option in MyComplianceOfffice with the pre-clearance requests listed below:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">Please also note that Securities Account/Associated Account statements can be updated to a Supervised Person&rsquo;s account using the &ldquo;Add a Trading Document&rdquo; option above.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">16.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Enforcement of this Code of Ethics</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">16.1.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">CCO</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">&rsquo;</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">s Duties and Responsibilities</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.5in; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">The CCO shall be primarily responsible for administering and enforcing the provisions of this Code. The CCO shall:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(i)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">supervise, implement and enforce the terms of this Code;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(ii)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">(a) provide each Supervised Person with a current copy of this Code and any amendments thereto, (b) notify each person who becomes a Supervised Person of the reporting requirements and other obligations under this Code at the time such person becomes a Supervised Person, and (c) require each Supervised Person to provide a signed Certificate of Compliance for this Code and the Firm&rsquo;s<I> Policy Regarding Management of Material Non-Public Information</I>;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 15; Value: 2 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2pt solid"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->15<!-- Field: /Sequence --></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="font: normal 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(iii)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">maintain a list of all securities and other financial instruments and assets which Sound Point recommends, holds, or is purchasing or selling, or intends to recommend purchase or sell on behalf of its Clients;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(iv)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">determine whether any particular personal securities transactions should be exempted pursuant to the provisions this Code;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(v)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">maintain files of statements and other information to be reviewed for the purpose of monitoring compliance with this Code, which information shall be kept confidential by Sound Point, except as required to enforce this Code, or to participate in any investigation concerning violations of applicable law;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(vi)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">review all Holdings Reports required to be provided by each Access Person pursuant to this Code: (a) for each new Supervised Person, to determine if any conflict of interest or other violation of this Code results from such person becoming a Supervised Person; and (b) for all Supervised Persons, to determine whether a violation of this Code has occurred;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(vii)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">review on a quarterly basis all securities reported on the quarterly transaction reports required to be provided by each Access Person pursuant to this Code for such calendar quarter to determine whether a Code violation may have occurred;</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(viii)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">review any other statements, records and reports required by this Code; and</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.7in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top">(ix)</TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">review on a periodic basis and update as necessary, this Code.</TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: right; vertical-align: top"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; width: 0.35in; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in; vertical-align: top"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">16.2.</FONT></B></TD>
    <TD STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><B><FONT STYLE="font-variant: small-caps">Violations of this Code of Ethics</FONT></B></TD> </TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">If the CCO determines that a violation of this Code has occurred, the CCO shall prepare a record of explanatory material regarding such violation and shall immediately take remedial or corrective action. The CCO shall monitor their own securities holdings and transactions in accordance with the reporting requirements set forth in this Policy.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0">If the CCO finds that a Supervised Person has violated this Code, the CCO will impose upon such Supervised Person sanctions that the CCO deems appropriate in view of the facts and circumstances. Sanctions with respect to any Supervised Person (other than a principal) may include written warning, suspension or termination of employment, a letter of censure and/or restitution of an amount equal to the difference between the price paid or received by the offending Supervised Person. In addition, Sound Point reserves the right to require the offending Supervised Person to reverse, cancel or freeze, at the Supervised Person&rsquo;s expense, any transaction or position in a specific Security if Sound Point believes the transaction or position violates this Code and/or Sound Point&rsquo;s general fiduciary duty to its Clients, or otherwise appears improper.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; margin: 0"><B>All violations of this Code must be immediately reported to the CCO.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>
